source: October 13 digital notebook; prompt wording retained, interior layout rebuilt for readable text and mirrored margins. Section labels replace Field Manual product labels.
instructions: Choose what gets your energy and what is officially not your problem.
Mark energy and mood at day's end. No essay. No performance.
Use the tracker and dashboard. Trust the receipts, not the spiral.
Release one expired story per section. Keep the lesson; delete the loop.
